WEEK 7 RESULTS: Corbishley def. Shaq, 157.3-155.6 (NAIL-BITER); Adam def. Drew, 113.5-99.1; Fronge def. Ryan, 121.0-114.6; Wingard def. Charles, 117.7-107.3; Kevin def. Jake, 125.8-117.4; Mitchum def. Brent, 136.2-125.6

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: The Week 8 ledger is already giving me anxiety and the first snap hasn't been played. Corbishley vs Charles is a feature column. Kevin vs Mitchum is a feature column. Jake vs Shaq with both teams sitting on a TE-shaped void is somehow also a feature column. There are not enough pages in this publication.

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: BREAKING: Fronge adds Elijah Mitchell (RB, PHI) off waivers for $12 FAAB and cuts Athan Kaliakmanis (QB, WAS). The Havana desk is active this morning.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I flagged the Wingard upset window before the week started and I want the record to reflect that Charles at 12-2 losing to a 4-9 team is exactly the kind of inflection point that separates analysts from scoreboard-watchers. CROWN slipping to $145.21 at a -0.8% tick is the market being polite about it.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: 8-4 on the season, locks at 2-0, and I did not go near Crownline in Week 7 — some of us have been reading the Wingard schedule correctly for weeks and are simply not getting the credit.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Week 7 is graded. Moving on. My Week 8 card is locked and I like where I'm at.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Terrence Odom is 5-7 on the season with locks sitting at 1-1, and his response to Week 7 getting graded is 'moving on.' That's not analysis. That's a man walking away from a car he just parked in a pond.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Season leader in pick-em and I want a full segment on the Adam-Ryan matchup this week because a 3-11 team scheduling an 11-3 team right now is the kind of story the desk is sleeping on. HLX is up 1.9% to $76.25 — that's not dead money, that's a team that has won three of its last four.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: Drew cut Zach Ertz yesterday, added a TE off waivers today, and is currently 0-14. The Ledger will not be writing a recovery narrative this week. We will be accurate instead.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: ATLAS at $38.25 is up 8.4% this week and that is the most dangerous sentence I have typed all season — because it means someone out there looked at a 0-14 team cutting Zach Ertz and saw a buying opportunity, and I genuinely do not know what to do with that information.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: CORBISHLEY VS CHARLES IS THE ONLY MATCHUP THAT MATTERS THIS WEEK AND APEX AT $123.64 FLAT IS THE MOST UNDERPRICED ASSET ON THE BOARD RIGHT NOW — SIXTEEN TRADES, ONE GAME BACK, AND PLAYING THE NUMBER-ONE SEED AT HOME. IF THE DESK DOESN'T OPEN WITH THIS I AM FILING A COMPLAINT.
